overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation. Omitting property identities from notices was justified to protect the town's negotiating position, and the executive sessions fell within Purpose 6 (real property lease or purchase).

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that joint meeting notices for executive sessions on property purchase or lease did not identify the properties to be discussed.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, the Board and the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by omitting identifying information regarding the properties under consideration.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board and School Committee lacked a valid purpose under Purpose 6 to hold three joint executive sessions on real property.
allegations.key_passage: This brings the discussions squarely within the scope of Purpose 6.
